PAINTING & BODYWORK · Painting

Fast Painting Workshop in Riyadh

Fast Painting is QSC's dedicated painting & bodywork facility in Riyadh. Send photos for a paint assessment and get a clear next step for your vehicle.

  1. Home
  2. Painting & Bodywork
  3. Fast Painting Workshop

Fast Painting is the name of QSC's dedicated painting and bodywork facility — the second of QSC's two workshops, operating at its own location and focused entirely on paint and body. Starting here is simple: describe the damage or the work you want, attach photos, and the painting team responds with an initial assessment and a clear next step. 'Fast' describes how directly you reach a decision — an efficient assessment and a straight answer — not a published turnaround time, which is only ever estimated per job after the car is seen.

Most paint decisions stall at the first step: the owner does not know whether the damage is trivial or serious, so the car keeps driving around wounded while quotes are imagined rather than obtained. Fast Painting removes that stall. Photographs sent by WhatsApp get a professional read — what the damage actually is, which repair class it falls into, what the realistic options look like — within working hours, with no visit required. Owners decide with facts, and the car comes in once, for the right job.

Behind the quick front door is the full depth of QSC's painting facility: the booths, color lab, body bay and chassis equipment described across these pages. 'Fast' was never about rushing cure times or skipping preparation — those physics do not negotiate. It is about an organization built so that assessment, decision and scheduling have no dead time in them. The work itself takes what quality takes, and you are told that duration honestly, per job, before you commit.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Is Fast Painting a different company from QSC?

No — it is QSC's own painting and bodywork facility, one of the two QSC workshops, at its own location. Maintenance work happens at the other facility.

Does 'fast' mean same-day painting?

No fixed turnaround is promised — proper preparation and curing take the time they take. What is fast is the path to an answer: send photos and you get an initial assessment and plan without needing a visit first.

What photos should I send?

Daylight, the whole affected panel from a step back, the damage straight-on and from an angle, and one wider shot of the car. Add the model and color if you know the color name or code.

Is Fast Painting more expensive because of the speed?

No — the speed is in the assessment and organization, not a premium service tier. Pricing follows the work the car needs, quoted after the damage is understood, the same as any QSC job.
